author_role: Same-project AI collaborator in a separate task-authoring agent session, not an independent external evaluator.
process: Authored all 16 natural-language specifications, 64 candidate expressions, and 96 expected example outputs before opening any existing challenge test or benchmark implementation. Expected outputs were derived by hand from the written specifications. The four authored semantic families are group_rejection (whole groups, per-group losses, combined losses, and separately depleted colors), ordered_selection (distinct role assignments and directed greetings), message_fanout (topic delivery, trace trees, relay archives, and stored endpoints), and pairwise_analysis (isolated, merged, repeated, and one-way cross-set comparisons). Each family has four tasks, two or three Nat arguments per task, and balanced intended positions. All modules are development material assigned to train. No affine tariff, capped capacity, absolute distance, refill, rectangle interior, or interval clamping task was authored. Intended indices live only in tests/test_transfer_corpus.py. After completing the corpus, consulted tests/test_challenge.py for the compiler-validation API shape and listed benchmark.py API definitions. Fixture checks pin this corpus hash; exhaustive compiler checks require all 64 candidates to type-check and exactly one per task to satisfy its examples. These corpus bytes must be frozen before any benchmark model run, with any correction requiring a new hash and renewed quality checks.
exposure_disclosure: The author received the parent agent's bounded task assignment, including the schema, arithmetic syntax, and names of six excluded historical task families. Before completing the corpus, the author did not read existing diagnostic or challenge corpora, their expected outputs, benchmark model responses, prompts, scoring implementations, or baseline implementations. After completing the corpus, reading the permitted challenge test module exposed old task names and intended indices, but not old task specifications or model outputs. The benchmark API is imported for mechanical compiler validation. The parent then reviewed all 96 expected outputs without reporting a discrepancy and noted that the rejected-badge formula can share algebraic structure with a historical geometric task. Different semantic settings do not establish disjoint mathematical templates. Independence means fresh authorship within this agent session with these exposure limits; this is a same-project development diagnostic, not a sealed test, independently administered evaluation, or evidence of uncontaminated external generalization. The task author did not run a benchmark model or tune tasks against model performance. Novelty refers to authored semantic settings relative to the supplied excluded families, not a verified claim about every task elsewhere in the project.
